description: This line plot, titled "BBQ", illustrates the accuracy of four different models—labeled "Squared Exponential", "Tanh", "ELU", and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B"—as a function of the number of demonstrations, which is plotted on the x-axis labeled "#Demonstrations" and ranges from 0 to 1500 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", ranges from 45 to 55 on a linear scale. The "Squared Exponential" model is represented by a dark blue solid line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 53.5 at 0 demonstrations and rising to a peak of about 56.5 at 250 demonstrations before leveling off near 56.5. The "Tanh" model is shown as a dark blue dashed line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 48.5 and remaining nearly constant at around 48.5 across the entire range. The "ELU" model is depicted as a dark blue dash-dotted line with circular markers, starting at approximately 47.5 and also remaining nearly constant at around 47.5. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model is represented by a light blue solid line with circular markers, starting at approximately 46.5 and remaining nearly constant at around 46.5 throughout the plot.
